tool.name: heasoft-demo
tool.help:
HEASOFT =======
This service provides access to Swift BAT HEASOFT tools. The list of parameters corresponds to one defined in standard HEASOFT par files.
References ----------
- **HEASoft (FTOOLS/XANADU Unified Package)** HEASARC. *HEASoft: Unified Release of FTOOLS and XANADU*. Version 6.35.2, 2025. https://heasarc.gsfc.nasa.gov/docs/software/heasoft/
- **HEASoftPy (Python Interface for HEASoft Tools)** HEASARC. *HEASoftPy: Python Interface for HEASoft Tools*. Accessed August 2025. https://heasarc.gsfc.nasa.gov/lheasoft/heasoftpy/
- **Swift BAT Toolset** NASA/Swift Team. *Swift BAT Software Tools*. Includes ``batbinevt``, ``batmaskwtevt``, ``batgrbproduct``, etc. https://heasarc.gsfc.nasa.gov/docs/software/lheasoft/help/swift.html
- **``batsurvey``: Swift BAT Survey Mode Data Processing Tool** NASA/Swift Team. *batsurvey Tool Help Page*. Accessed August 2025. https://heasarc.gsfc.nasa.gov/docs/software/lheasoft/help/batsurvey.html
- **``batgrbproduct``: Swift GRB Processing Pipeline** NASA/Swift Team. *batgrbproduct Tool Help Page*. Accessed August 2025. https://heasarc.gsfc.nasa.gov/docs/software/lheasoft/help/batgrbproduct.html
